## Grading summary

**Pairings:** every record item pairs with a key item; there are no unpaired extras.

| Key | Record | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| e1 wedding/engagement | 2 | Captured (engagement itself not stated, date given as "June 2027" vs. June 12) |
| e2 promotion | 1 | Captured; Oct 1 correct (salary/refresh detail omitted, nothing wrong) |
| e3 home purchase | 3 | Captured |
| a1 sell 2,080 RSUs | 4 | 2,080 @ $96.05 = $199,784 — all correct, uses corrected share count |
| a2 transfer to 4471 | 5 | $199,784 to Pellbrook 4471 — correct |
| a3 T-bill ladder | 6 | $185,000, Jan/Feb/Mar 2027 — correct |
| a4 exercise & hold 900 ISOs | 7 | 900 and first week of December correct; wording "exercise and **sell**… exercise and hold" is self-contradictory and imports the declined same-day-sale language |
| i1 send grant docs to Rhea | 8 | Owner Tessa correct (reassignment caught); **due is wrong** — record says 2026-11-20, meeting said tomorrow morning, Fri Sep 11. Also carries the mis-transcribed "Rhea Della Cross," corrected on the call to Delacroix |
| i2 final AMT projection (Nell, Nov 20) | 0 | **Missing** — the Nov 20 date was instead attached to i1 |
| i3 $9,000 Q3 estimate (Jonah, Sep 15) | 0 | **Missing** |
| i4 Ferncastle pre-approval | 11 | Owner Maren, due Oct 2 (the moved date, not Sep 18) — correct |
| i5 standing sell-at-vest election | 9 | Owner Jonah, due Nov 15 — correct |
| i6 401(k) beneficiary | 10 | Owner Jonah, due Sep 30 — correct |

**Non-actions:** none of n1 (DAF), n2 (exchange fund), n3 (declined 1,500-ISO same-day sale) or n4 (risk step-down) were recorded as actions. Note that item 7's "exercise and sell" phrasing echoes the declined recommendation, but it is 900 shares in December, so it reads as the a4 exercise-and-hold, not n3.

**Main defects:** two missing action items (i2, i3), a wrong due date on i1, and the hold/sell contradiction in item 7.

key_items.note: "Wedding in June 2027" captures the wedding; date is less precise than June 12, 2027 but not wrong. Engagement/Portugal proposal not separately noted.
Staff engineer effective October 1 is correct; salary step to $236,000 and 1,600-RSU refresh omitted but no incorrect figure carried.
"House purchase in spring 2027" matches the Feb-Mar offers / close by April plan; no figures carried, so nothing wrong.

$185,000 ladder with January, February, March 2027 maturities is correct; the ~$14,784 money market remainder is not mentioned but no figure is wrong.

900 ISOs and first week of December are right (900 was the corrected number after the 1,900 audio garble); $31.40 strike and $28,260 cost omitted. Wording "Exercise and sell 900 ISOs ... exercise and hold" is self-contradictory and imports the declined same-day-sale language. Due 2026-12-01 sits in the first week of December, though the meeting framed the exercise as following the December 3 review.

Owner correctly reassigned from Jonah to Tessa Varnum. Due date is wrong: recorded 2026-11-20, but Tessa said she would send the documents tomorrow morning, Friday September 11, 2026 (Nov 20 is i2's deadline). Also carries "Rhea Della Cross," the mis-transcribed name Nell corrected to Rhea Delacroix; the Parrish Lane vesting export is not mentioned.
Missing. No record item covers Nell chasing Rhea Delacroix for the final AMT projection and the December ISO count by November 20, 2026; that date was instead misapplied to item 8.

Owner Maren Tolliver and due 2026-10-02 both match the final decision, correctly using the moved date rather than the original end of next week (September 18).

401(k) beneficiary change to Maren, owner Jonah, due 2026-09-30 (end of September) all correct; Orrinfell benefits portal detail omitted but nothing is wrong.
